shortDescription: Manage lines in text files on OpenWrt targets

options.name: backrefs
options.description: Used with O(regex). If set, the line is inserted/replaced only if the regex matches. The matched groups can be referenced in O(line) using backreferences.

options.name: create
options.description: Create the file if it does not exist. Without this option, the task fails if the file does not exist.

options.name: follow
options.description: Whether to follow symlinks when setting file attributes. When V(false), symlinks are not followed and attributes are set on the link itself (where supported). When V(true), attributes are set on the symlink target. Affects how O(mode), O(owner), and O(group) are applied.

options.name: group
options.description: Group name that should own the file or directory. Passed directly to the C(chgrp) command. If not specified, group ownership is not changed. Not applied to symlinks when O(follow=false).

options.name: insertafter
options.description: Used with O(state=present). If specified, the line is inserted after the last match of the specified regular expression. Special values V(EOF) for end of file and V(BOF) for beginning of file.

options.name: insertbefore
options.description: Used with O(state=present). If specified, the line is inserted before the last match of the specified regular expression. Special value V(BOF) for beginning of file.

options.name: line
options.description: The line to insert/replace into the file. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: mode
options.description: Permissions for the file or directory. Can be specified as an octal number (for example, V('0644'), V('1777')) or symbolic mode (like V('u+rwx')). When using octal notation, quote the value to ensure it is treated as a string. If not specified, permissions may be determined by the system default C(umask) or remain unchanged. Not applied to symlinks when O(follow=false).

options.name: owner
options.description: User name that should own the file or directory. Passed directly to the C(chown) command. If not specified, ownership is not changed. Not applied to symlinks when O(follow=false).

options.name: regex
options.description: The regular expression to look for in every line of the file. For O(state=present), the pattern to replace if found. For O(state=absent), the pattern of the line(s) to remove.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the line should be present or absent.
